acceptanceCriteria: An unmerged failed delivery can record an abandoned finalization only when the PR is explicitly closed, branch/worktree cleanup is proven, failure code unmerged_pull_request is bound, and no mergeCommit is present.
Merged PR finalization remains unchanged and abandoned receipts cannot authorize a successful or merged governance projection.
finalize-verify, close, and promote_closed_work_item.py --check-all accept the new terminal state with preserved failure evidence.
Existing resource finalization and repository governance tests remain green.
Tri-language reference rules distinguish abandoned unmerged cleanup from successful merged deletion and preserve fail-closed retained/blocked/unknown behavior.
goal: Add a truthful, identity-bound abandoned finalization state for cleaned unmerged failed deliveries, validate it fail-closed, project it through close and documentation audits, and preserve all existing merged-resource semantics.
intent: Repair the Runtime finalization protocol so an explicitly closed unmerged failed PR can be finalized and closed without being represented as merged.
